hook.text: You have one real name but dozens of online identities. Each one reveals a different slice of who you are.

buildup.text: Usernames, avatars, and bios create online personas — versions of yourself tailored for different platforms.

discovery.text: Researchers can often link anonymous accounts to real identities using writing style and posting patterns.

twist.text: Even 'anonymous' accounts develop recognizable patterns. True anonymity requires constant, deliberate effort.

climax.text: Your online personas feel separate. But data brokers and investigators can stitch them into one picture.

quiz.question: How can anonymous accounts be linked to real identities?
options: Through writing style analysis and posting patterns
Anonymous accounts can never be identified
